title: VariantShift Conservative Auditor v2 outcome-blind confirmation
claim: An outcome-free confidence score can identify tasks on which deploying the best fixed development model, VespaG, is safer than indiscriminate deployment; the policy may deploy VespaG or abstain and may not select another model.
development_disclosure: The method was adaptively redesigned using ProteinGym plus the explicitly revealed MaveDB/Venus development pilot. Its family-held-out development gate passed, but leave-one-panel-out transport failed. Confirmation may therefore support either a positive reliability result or a decisive negative transport result; no post-reveal refitting is permitted.

primary_endpoints.utility: within-task standardized selection gain among the top-scored decile
primary_endpoints.failure: standardized selection gain less than or equal to zero
primary_endpoints.reliability: area under the task-level selection-regret coverage curve

primary_comparator: Always deploy VespaG, with analytical expected performance under random task abstention at each coverage.
secondary_endpoints: mean selection gain at 50 percent task coverage
task_weighting: Each assay receives equal weight; no assay is weighted by its number of measured variants.

hierarchy: Pfam clan or frozen MMseqs2 fallback family
bootstrap.primary_contrast: Always-VespaG regret-coverage AUC minus Conservative Auditor v2 regret-coverage AUC

selector.method: Panel-balanced Extra Trees regressors for VespaG utility and six-model selection regret; confidence is the harmonic mean of predicted utility percentile and one minus predicted regret percentile.
selector.decision: At each declared task-coverage level, deploy VespaG on tasks with the highest frozen outcome-free confidence and abstain on the rest. Pooled and within-panel rankings are frozen before outcomes; model overrides are prohibited.

inclusion.domainome: All frozen Domainome targets with at least 95 percent shared substitution coverage for the declared analysis panel.
inclusion.mavedb_complement: Only tasks in the immutable untouched_holdout partition with frozen metadata direction.
inclusion.venusmuthub: Only tasks in the immutable untouched_holdout partition with deterministic activity direction and at least ten aligned substitutions.

exclusion.development_pilot: Every task assigned to development_pilot is excluded from confirmation.
exclusion.direction: Ambiguous signed selectivity and unsupported assay directions are excluded without consulting effects.
exclusion.coverage: Model-task pairs below 95 percent frozen substitution coverage are excluded from the complete-intersection primary benchmark and retained in the missingness audit.
exclusion.parser: Coordinate or reference mismatches are excluded only by frozen parser rules; no performance-based exclusion is allowed.

primary_order: pooled regret-coverage contrast versus always VespaG
mean utility noninferiority at 50 percent coverage
confirmatory_tests.multiplicity: The pooled primary contrast is tested first; gated secondary and panel-specific contrasts use Holm adjustment.
confirmatory_tests.missingness: Report complete-model intersections and model-available sensitivity analyses without imputing variant predictions.

negative_result_rule: If any primary gate fails, VariantShift v2 is not claimed to improve deployment reliability. The result is reported as evidence that development benchmarks do not support transportable outcome-free auditing.
figures: failure rate and selection gain at 50 percent task coverage
sequence, clan, structure, exposure, and assay subgroup forest plots
ten-model Domainome benchmark heatmap and rank stability
outcome_access_policy: No remaining effect or measurement file may be mounted, decoded, downloaded, or hashed until the complete v2 bundle is frozen and publicly timestamped on OSF or Zenodo.
